# Shop settings

Each shop's settings, changed in the admin panel under Settings (appearance ones on the Bot menu screen) or through `PUT /api/admin/settings`. Secret values are stored encrypted and never returned. The Backups group is server-wide: it is set on the Backups page (`PUT /api/admin/backups/schedule`), and an unset value there falls back to the matching `BACKUP_*` environment setting.

## General

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bot_enabled` | bool | true | Bot is on. When off, users only get the maintenance message and the Mini App is closed. Staff (you included) still see the bot as usual so they can work; test from an ordinary account. It can take up to 15 seconds |
| `languages` | list | ["fa", "en"] | Bot languages. Language codes, e.g. fa, en |
| `require_phone` | bool | false | Ask for phone number. People share their number before using the bot |
| `phone_country_codes` | list | [] | Allowed country codes. For example 98; empty allows all |
| `phone_when` | str | "entry" | When to ask for the phone. Entry: before anything. Purchase: only before the first purchase |
| `support_username` | str | "" | Support username. Without @ |
| `terms_required` | bool | false | Require terms |
| `terms_version` | int | 1 | Terms version. Raising it asks everyone to accept again |
| `terms_when` | str | "entry" | When to ask for the terms. Entry: before anything in the bot and Mini App. Purchase: only before buying (and after each new version) |
| `typed_confirm_enabled` | bool | false | Type to confirm deletions. Deleting a service, a bulk delete or disable, and a large refund need a typed confirmation. Turn it on after the panel shows the confirm dialog |
| `typed_confirm_refund_min` | int | 1000000 | Typed confirmation for refunds from (Toman). Refunds of this amount or more need the amount typed. Empty: never |
| `auto_replies` | list | [] | Auto replies. When a free message contains one of these words, the bot answers with this instead of the menu |

## Free trial

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trial_enabled` | bool | true | Free trial on |
| `trial_panel_id` | int | — | Trial panel. Panel number; empty uses the first active panel |
| `trial_days` | int | 1 | Trial days |
| `trial_gb` | int | 1 | Trial data (GB) |
| `trial_generation` | int | 1 | Trial round. Raising it lets everyone take a trial again |
| `trial_daily_quota` | int | 0 | Daily trial limit. 0 means no limit |
| `trial_requires_phone` | bool | false | Trial needs phone |
| `trial_min_account_minutes` | int | 0 | New account wait before trial (minutes). A brand-new account gets no free trial until this much time has passed. 0 turns it off. Makes accounts created only for a trial costlier |

## Referrals

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `referral_enabled` | bool | true | Referrals on |
| `referral_required` | bool | false | Invitation only (inviter required). A newcomer must come through a customer's invite link or send their invite code. Customers who bought before, and staff, are exempt |
| `referral_percent` | int | 10 | Reward percent. Of the referred person's first purchase |
| `referral_min_order` | int | 0 | Smallest first order that earns a referral reward (Toman) |
| `referral_daily_max` | int | 0 | Referral rewards per inviter per day. Stops reward farming with fake accounts; 0 means no limit |
| `referral_monthly_max` | int | 0 | Referral rewards per inviter per 30 days. 0 means no limit |
| `referral_every_purchase` | bool | false | Referral reward on every purchase. Off: only the invited customer's first purchase pays the inviter |
| `referral_repeat_percent` | int | — | Referral percent on later purchases. Empty uses the same percent as the first purchase |
| `referral_reward_mode` | str | "cash" | Invite reward. What the inviter gets: a share of the friend's purchase in the wallet, a free config for every few invites, or both |
| `referral_config_counts` | str | "purchase" | When an invite counts. “On purchase”: a friend counts with their first qualifying purchase (the same minimum as the cash reward), so fake accounts gain nothing. “On join”: as soon as they join with the link. Banned customers never count |
| `referral_config_every` | int | 5 | Invites per config. One free config for every this many counted invites (1 to 1000) |
| `referral_config_source` | str | "plan" | Free config source. One of the shop's plans, or a size and duration on a panel |
| `referral_config_plan_id` | int | — | Free config plan. Used when the source is “A plan” |
| `referral_config_gb` | int | 5 | Free config size (GB). Used when the source is “Custom size and days” |
| `referral_config_days` | int | 30 | Free config duration (days). Used when the source is “Custom size and days” |
| `referral_config_panel_id` | int | — | Free config panel. Used when the source is “Custom size and days”: the config is made on this panel |
| `start_gift_amount` | int | 0 | Welcome gift for new customers (Toman). Added to the wallet once, on first /start. 0 turns it off; keep it small |
| `start_gift_referred_only` | bool | true | Welcome gift only for invited customers |
| `catalog_discount_percent` | int | 0 | Time-limited shop discount (%). On plan prices for customers; resellers keep their own prices. 0 is off |
| `catalog_discount_until` | str | "" | Discount ends. Empty: until you turn it off |
| `catalog_discount_category_ids` | list | [] | Only these categories |
| `loyalty_enabled` | bool | false | Loyalty levels. Customers who spend more get a standing discount. Resellers keep their own discount |
| `loyalty_tiers` | list | [] | Levels. Total spent on completed orders to reach each level, and its discount (up to 50%) |
| `wheel_enabled` | bool | false | Lucky wheel. A Lucky wheel button in the bot gives a spin with a prize from the list below |
| `wheel_every_hours` | int | 24 | Hours between spins |
| `wheel_buyers_only` | bool | true | Wheel only for buyers |
| `wheel_prizes` | list | [{"label": "5,000", "kind": "wallet", "value": 5000, "weight": 30}, {"label": "10%", "kind": "discount", "value": 10, "weight": 20}, {"label": "20,000", "kind": "wallet", "value": 20000, "weight": 5}, {"label": "-", "kind": "nothing", "value": 0, "weight": 45}] | Wheel prizes. The chance of each slice is its weight against the total. Discount prizes become a one-time code valid for 7 days |
| `lottery_enabled` | bool | false | Lottery button. Shows the Lottery button in the bot. Lotteries themselves are set up on the Lotteries page |
| `trust_channel_id` | int | — | Trust channel. ID of a public channel where the bot is an admin. Every paid purchase and renewal is posted there as a report with the buyer's id masked (for example 56943******), the plan, category, service and amount, plus a buy button. At most 20 posts go out per hour |

| `receipt_duplicate_block` | bool | false | Block duplicate receipts. When off, duplicates are only flagged |
| `card_auto_approve` | bool | false | Auto-approve receipts. Small receipts from customers with a clean history are approved without review; duplicates never are |
| `card_auto_max_amount` | int | 300000 | Auto-approve up to |
| `card_auto_min_history` | int | 3 | Approved receipts needed first |
| `card_auto_approve_after_minutes` | int | 0 | Approve unreviewed receipts after (minutes). 0 turns it off. Only up to the auto-approve amount; duplicates and risky customers always wait for a person |
| `card_pick` | str | "all" | Which card customers see. all, random (one at random) or rotate (one card after another) |
| `card_random_tail` | bool | false | Add a random tail to card amounts. A few Toman (up to 999) so every receipt matches one payment; the extra goes to the customer's wallet |
| `card_sms_enabled` | bool | false | Confirm card payments by bank SMS. An SMS forwarder app on the phone that receives the account's SMS posts each message to https://<domain>/api/sms/card/<shop id> with the key in the X-Api-Key header (or a key field). A deposit SMS whose amount matches exactly one open payment approves it. While on, every card payment asks for a unique amount |
| `card_sms_secret` | str (secret) | — | SMS webhook key. At least 24 random characters. Anyone holding it can approve payments; enter it only in the forwarder app |
| `card_verify_enabled` | bool | false | Customers register their card first. Before paying card to card, the customer sends the card number and a photo of the card; staff approve it in the bot. Trusted customers skip this |
| `card_verify_min_amount` | int | 0 | Card registration needed from (Toman). 0 means for every card payment |
| `topup_bonus_rules` | list | [] | Top-up bonus. A share of each top-up added as a gift. The largest matching bonus applies |
| `wallet_transfer_enabled` | bool | false | Customers can send balance to each other |
| `wallet_transfer_min` | int | 10000 | Smallest transfer (Toman) |
| `wallet_transfer_daily_max` | int | 5000000 | Most a customer can send a day (Toman). 0 means no daily limit |
| `nowpayments_enabled` | bool | false | NowPayments |
| `nowpayments_api_key` | str (secret) | — | NowPayments API key |
| `nowpayments_ipn_secret` | str (secret) | — | NowPayments IPN secret |
| `plisio_enabled` | bool | false | Plisio |
| `plisio_api_key` | str (secret) | — | Plisio API key |

| `abangateway_api_key` | str (secret) | — | AbanGateway API key |
| `abangateway_rial` | bool | true | AbanGateway reports amounts in Rial. Leave on unless AbanGateway tells you its verify answer is in Toman. A wrong choice keeps payments waiting for review; it never credits too much |
| `blupal_enabled` | bool | false | BluPal. Open invoices are checked every minute. For faster crediting set the webhook in the BluPal dashboard to your server's public address followed by /api/pay/gw/blupal |
| `blupal_api_key` | str (secret) | — | BluPal API key |
| `tronado_enabled` | bool | false | Tronado (TRX). Customers pay in TRX through the Tronado bot; the amount is converted at Tronado's rate. Needs the server's public address |
| `tronado_api_key` | str (secret) | — | Tronado API key |
| `tronado_ipn_key` | str (secret) | — | Tronado callback signing key |
| `tronado_wallet` | str | "" | Tronado TRON wallet. The TRC20 address Tronado pays out to. Use a different one from the wallet in the Crypto group |
| `tronado_wage_percent` | int | 0 | Share of Tronado's fee you pay (%). 0 means the customer pays the whole fee, 100 means you do |
| `cubepay_enabled` | bool | false | CubePay. Card-to-card and crypto through CubePay. Needs the server's public address |
| `cubepay_api_key` | str (secret) | — | CubePay API token |
| `cubepay_fee_percent` | int | 0 | CubePay fee added to the price (%). Added on top of what the customer pays at CubePay; the wallet gets the original amount |
| `tonpay_enabled` | bool | false | Tonpay (standard invoices). Disabled by default. Requires PUBLIC_URL and a Tonpay key. Only server-verified Toman payments settle; amount differences require review. Custom receipt mode is not supported |
| `tonpay_api_key` | str (secret) | — | Tonpay API key |
| `tonpay_custom_enabled` | bool | false | Tonpay custom checkout. Tonpay card transfer for wallet top-ups in the Mini App. To switch it on: the Tonpay "Telegram bot" API key, financial policy approved, paid confirmation on, and all three timings below above zero; save them together |
| `tonpay_custom_api_key` | str (secret) | — | Tonpay custom API key. The API key from the "Telegram bot" tab of Tonpay's custom gateway (not the website key). No webhook secret is needed; the bot asks Tonpay about every payment itself |
| `tonpay_custom_credential_epoch` | str | "" | Tonpay custom credential version (server-managed) |
| `tonpay_custom_policy_approved` | bool | false | Tonpay custom financial policy approved |
| `tonpay_custom_confirm_enabled` | bool | false | Enable Tonpay custom paid confirmation |
| `tonpay_custom_receipt_wait` | int | 0 | Tonpay custom wait before receipt submission (seconds). Seconds after the invoice is made before the customer may send a receipt. Above zero and below the payment expiry; e.g. 60 |
| `tonpay_custom_card_cooldown` | int | 0 | Tonpay custom card change cooldown (seconds). Shortest gap between two new-card requests by the customer. Above zero; e.g. 300 |
| `tonpay_custom_review_window` | int | 0 | Tonpay custom receipt review window (seconds). Time Tonpay has to review a receipt. Above zero; e.g. 1800 |
| `atlaspay_enabled` | bool | false | AtlasPay. AtlasPay has no callback; open orders are checked every minute. AtlasPay's own markup is shown to the customer before paying |
| `atlaspay_api_key` | str (secret) | — | AtlasPay API key |

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alerts_muted` | list | [] | Admin alerts. For each event, choose whether staff chats and the report group get it. The panel's inbox always has everything |
| `daily_report_hour` | int | 23 | Daily report hour. Tehran time, 0 to 23 |
| `daily_report_enabled` | bool | true | Daily report. A summary of each day to the report group (reports topic) or staff chats |
| `reseller_daily_report` | bool | false | Daily report for resellers. Each reseller gets its purchases, balance and its bot's sales every night |
| `daily_report_sections` | list | ["summary", "money", "panels"] | Daily report parts. Each part is its own message |
| `log_retention_days` | int | 30 | Keep logs (days) |

## Backups

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `backup_auto_enabled` | bool | true | Automatic backups |
| `backup_every_hours` | int | 24 | How often |
| `backup_hour` | int | — | Hour. Server time ({timezone}) |
| `backup_keep` | int | — | Copies to keep. Older copies are deleted |
| `backup_send_telegram` | bool | — | Send to Telegram. To the Backups channel under Channels, or to the owner when none is set |
| `backup_bot_token` | str (secret) | — | — |
| `backup_chat_ids` | list | [] | — |
